prompt:
ORTHOGRAPHIC VERTICAL OVERHEAD PLAN VIEW. Camera directly above, looking straight down into the object from above. Rectangular edges run horizontally and vertically on the canvas. Show no vertical outside faces.

Create an ORIGINAL game building sprite for the D'thorga inspection pit: a long narrow mechanic's pit sunk into a workshop floor, where parts are checked from below before they leave the workbench, in a hard-scrabble frontier colony. Image 1 is our approved vehicle parts bench from the same family: match its outline weight, shading, palette and finish only. Do NOT copy its shape or contents.

Wide canvas. The pit fills about 90 percent of the canvas width and 70 percent of its height, centred, on a plain pure white background. It is three times as long as it is wide.

Its plan, from left to right: at the left end, three shallow concrete steps going down into the pit; along the middle, the dark recessed floor of the pit seen from above, with a plain steel drain grate and one small caged work lamp fixed to the inside wall; at the right end, a small square steel parts lift platform on a short scissor jack, with one muted orange handle. A thick pale concrete rim runs all round the opening, with a narrow band of worn yellow and dark diagonal hazard paint along its inner edge.

Style: a sprite for the game RimWorld: a thick near-black outline around every shape, soft flat cel shading with two or three tones per material, pale panels, rounded corners, a few small clean details, no texture noise. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not pixel art.

No people, animals, vehicles, tools lying about, text, letters, numbers, logos, dials, screens or dust. No floor beyond the rim, no shadow outside the pit, no perspective, no tilt.
